import React from 'react'; import { useLocation } from 'react-router-dom'; import { listings } from '../list'; // Adjust the path as necessary function SearchResults() { const location = useLocation(); const searchParams = new URLSearchParams(location.search); const query = searchParams.get('query')?.toLowerCase() || ''; // Filter listings based on the search query const filteredListings = Object.entries(listings).flatMap(([category, items]) => items.filter( (item) => item.title.toLowerCase().includes(query) || item.location.toLowerCase().includes(query) || category.toLowerCase().includes(query) ) ); return (
{/* Sidebar Filter Section */}

Filter

{/* Results Section */}

Search Results for "{query}"

{filteredListings.length > 0 ? (
{filteredListings.map((listing) => (
{/* Image Section */}
{/* Content Section */}

{listing.title}

{listing.price}

{listing.location}

{listing.description?.substring(0, 100)}...

))}
) : (

No results found for "{query}".

)}
); } export default SearchResults;
